title.zh: 可演进服务与迁移交接

brief.zh: 服务使用方仍有以元为单位的旧客户端，新客户端需要整数分。保持记录身份，分别提供两个版本的响应和兼容检查，再写清迁移边界。
brief.en: A consuming team needs a new cents-based response while an old client still expects yuan. Preserve IDs and both versioned contracts.

zh: 版本化服务和迁移方案
回归、诊断与接手运行说明
en: old/new contract tests and migration notes

zh: 旧调用方回归和新行为符合契约
迁移前后数据与故障恢复核对
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
Changing the old client to cents without a version change breaks compatibility. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 只按空库测试导致旧数据迁移失败必须暴露
failure.en: Changing the old client to cents without a version change breaks compatibility.

en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 服务使用方仍有以元为单位的旧客户端，新客户端需要整数分。保持记录身份，分别提供两个版本的响应和兼容检查，再写清迁移边界。
只按空库测试导致旧数据迁移失败必须暴露；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A consuming team needs a new cents-based response while an old client still expects yuan.
Reproduce this failure first: Changing the old client to cents without a version change breaks compatibility.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
variants.newJudgment: 只按空库测试导致旧数据迁移失败必须暴露
variants.status: fixed-base; new instances require explicit generation and frozen identities

sourceDescription.zh: 本站原创合成材料与代码，方法链接按阅读范围标注
sourceDescription.en: Original synthetic inputs and code; method links have bounded reading records
